articles.title: Ceiling Collapses at Kennedy Center: What Happened?
articles.summary: A piece of ceiling fell in the Kennedy Center's hallway, and no one was hurt. The center's board says it shows why they need to close for repairs. But some people disagree.

articles.title: Protesters Block Roads at Port of Dover: What's Going On?
articles.summary: Hundreds of masked protesters blocked roads at the Port of Dover, chanting 'stop the boats.' Police cleared them in a few hours. No one was arrested, and the port is back to normal.

articles.title: Reform UK in Trouble: Secret Filming Causes Big Problems
articles.summary: A secret video caused two leaders of Reform UK to lose their jobs. The party is worried it looks bad. Some insiders say they need to be more careful, like 'roundheads' instead of 'cavaliers.'
